paper.title_en: Fundamental Noise Processes in Pulsar Timing
paper.abstract_en: The stability of spin rates and emission regions of radio-emitting neutron stars (pulsars) has enabled remarkable advances, including the detection of exoplanets, testing theories of gravity, and stimulating the vigorous exploration of a new window in gravitational wave astronomy an nanohertz frequencies. An ideal astrophysical clock would emit identical pulses at a constant rate, propagating along single geodesics through a perfect vacuum. In reality, the timing precision achievable with pulsars is limited by spin noise, variability in the beam produced in a complex magnetosphere, and multipath propagation through a turbulent interstellar medium, with additional limitations from uncertainties in the changing pulsar -- observatory vector and instrumental effects. Here we present the fundamentals of pulsar timing, its current limitations, and prospects for improvements in timing precision. We develop metrics to assess the timing quality of a pulsar and use them to evaluate sources currently included in pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) as a means for characterizing the quality of future pulsar discoveries. With increases in telescope sensitivity, pulsar timing precision will increasingly be limited by propagation effects in the interstellar medium. We identify sources of non-Gaussianity in timing residuals and separate out effects that are chromatic or achromatic, as well as effects that vary on short (seconds to minutes) and longer (days to months) timescales. Modern wide-bandwidth receivers provide simultaneous arrival times across a range of frequencies, enabling the robust mitigation of chromatic interstellar effects and the identification of non-Gaussian events superimposed on random fluctuations. We recommend changes to timing procedures that leverage instrumentation advances to improve timing precision.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该摘要聚焦脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）的计时噪声基础问题，系统讨论了自旋噪声、磁层束变化、星际介质多路径传播以及仪器效应等限制计时精度的因素，并提出评估计时质量的指标、区分色差与非色差效应以及利用宽带接收机缓解色散效应的方法。这与PTA方向高度相关，且提供了可操作的方法论线索，适合进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时中的基本噪声过程
decision.abstract_zh: 射电辐射中子星（脉冲星）自转速率与辐射区域的稳定性带来了显著进展，包括系外行星探测、引力理论检验，以及推动了在纳赫兹频率上探索引力波天文学新窗口的蓬勃研究。一个理想的天体物理时钟应以恒定速率发射完全相同的脉冲，并沿单条测地线穿过完美真空传播。现实中，脉冲星可达到的计时精度受到自旋噪声、复杂磁层中辐射束的变化以及湍流星际介质中多路径传播的限制，此外还受到脉冲星—观测站矢量变化的不确定性以及仪器效应带来的限制。本文介绍脉冲星计时的基本原理、当前局限以及提高计时精度的前景。我们开发了评估脉冲星计时质量的指标，并用其评估当前纳入脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）的源，以此表征未来脉冲星发现的质量。随着望远镜灵敏度的提高，脉冲星计时精度将日益受到星际介质中传播效应的限制。我们识别计时残差中非高斯性的来源，并区分色差与非色差效应，以及在短时标（秒至分钟）和较长时标（天至月）上变化的效应。现代宽带接收机可提供跨频率范围的同步到达时间，从而能够稳健地缓解色差星际效应，并识别叠加在随机涨落之上的非高斯事件。我们建议调整计时流程，利用仪器进展来提高计时精度。
